title: Add CONTRIBUTING.md with the team repo standards
summary: CONTRIBUTING.md links the wiki page Software Onboarding - Repo Standards and repeats its rules: uv-only environments, [netid]/[task] branches, every change through a pull request with green CI, no secrets or checkpoints outside Git LFS, and hash-bound results at the 0.040 rad per 20 ms limiter. README links the file, and the contributor guide now requires branch-plus-pull-request publication instead of direct pushes to main.
next: Contributors open pull requests from [netid]/[task] branches; the leads decide on a Git LFS migration for artifacts.
reason: This change records contribution rules and adds no experiment or qualification evidence.
